integrity: All stated eigenvalues and multiplicities follow from the analytic proof for all prime powers; the 11 finite NumPy checks corroborate but do not establish universality. Originality is evidence-bounded and independently unvalidated.
scientific_limitations: Degree zero plus one Grassmann spherical band and fixed point-containing Schubert stars only; no higher-degree or general Schubert window classification; possible equivalent historical q-Johnson incidence formulation remains a literature risk.
title: Two-level Slepian spectrum for point stars in finite Grassmann schemes
